info.name: Mews Booking Engine API (Distributor) Account notes Cashier transactions API

items.docs: Returns all cashier transactions. At least one of the filter parameters `CashierTransactionIds` or `CreatedUtc` must be specified in the request. Note this operation uses [Pagination](../guidelines/pagination.md) and supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property/).
